implementation: A finite monotonic value is required before cleanup. A missing, invalid, or nonfinite clock returns cached CLOSE_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN without starting cleanup.
The same shared two-second deadline is sampled immediately after the cleanup-thread join and after any serve-thread join. now > deadline sets timed_out even when the joined thread has stopped.

A final finite monotonic sample occurs immediately before confirmation. Confirmation requires final elapsed_seconds in 0..2.0 and a nonexpired deadline in addition to completed shutdown, two stopped owned threads, closed owned socket, and null error.
A late completed join is cached as CLOSE_TIMEOUT. Sequential repeat returns the identical result and starts no second cleanup thread; late completion cannot upgrade it.
